_doc: Extra AI calls to log (event 'call'), args/results described automatically. Full names from `mod find`. Only direct call sites are traced (virtual/closure calls are reported as untraceable). Avoid per-tick functions (huge logs). Re-run `mod testbed on` after editing.
_avoid: Per-tick/per-frame (flood the log): AIMilitary.checkStructures, Politics.checkAction, Spying.checkAssassinationTarget, AIMilitary.changeAggressiveness (via updateAggressiveness)., AIBattles.checkPeacefulAnnexation (~186/min), Spying.tryLaunchOperationFromOrder (~109/min, always False), Spying.tryLaunchOperation (~104/min, always False). `mod log` flags any fn logged >30x per game-minute. AIMilitary.tryAction: 1:1 with tryGauge, args unparseable.
